note: Buildings per municipio: OpenStreetMap footprints (buildings_osm) plus footprints detected from imagery by machine, Google Open Buildings and Microsoft ML Buildings via Overture Maps, where OpenStreetMap has none (buildings_added; detections, not surveyed buildings). Every count is over both. Ground elevation: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar DEM at each building (median within 2 m of the centroid), metres above PRVD02, counted in 0.1 m steps; a bathtub screen. Flood zone: FEMA NFHL at the centroid. Storm surge: buildings in a cell with mapped inundation on the NOAA NHC storm surge risk map, by hurricane category (municipio-level screening; the publisher says not for parcel-level assessment). Landslide: buildings by USGS OFR 2020-1022 susceptibility class at the centroid, and by the highest class within 25 m. Full method in data/derived/exposure.json.
